mapper.sql:
b.b_active = 1
AND ( b.b_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.b_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.b_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
AND b.b_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_max_capacity = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_max_capacity BETWEEN 2 AND 5) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_max_capacity BETWEEN 6 AND 10) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_max_capacity BETWEEN 11 AND 20) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_max_capacity > 20) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND s.s_max_capacity >= 100)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_parking = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_hours24 = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_pet = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_desk = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_cafe = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_fax = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_storage = 1)
AND (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(b.b_latitude)) * cos(radians(b.b_altitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(b.b_latitude)))) < 5
mapper.select:
SELECT b.b_idx, b.b_name, b.b_address, b.b_description, b.b_latitude, b.b_altitude, b.b_phone, b.b_file, b.b_active, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_parking = 1) as fac_parking, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_hours24 = 1) as fac_hours24, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_pet = 1) as fac_pet, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_desk = 1) as fac_wifi, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_cafe = 1) as fac_coffee, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_fax = 1) as fac_printer, (SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM space s JOIN facilities f ON s.s_idx = f.s_idx WHERE s.b_idx = b.b_idx AND f.f_storage = 1) as fac_locker
, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(b.b_latitude)) * cos(radians(b.b_altitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(b.b_latitude)))) AS distance
FROM branch b
ORDER BY distance ASC, b.b_idx DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{skip}
SELECT b_idx, b_name, b_address, b_description, b_latitude, b_altitude, b_phone, b_file, b_active FROM branch WHERE b_active = 1
